metadata.title: [FEATURE][API]: Make tool description forbidden patterns configurable + fix auth_value encoding bug
metadata.author: CymruLavis

description:
## Summary

- Add `TOOL_DESCRIPTION_FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS_ENABLED` (bool, default `true`) to disable all forbidden pattern checks on tool descriptions
- Add `TOOL_DESCRIPTION_FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS` (JSON array, default: original hardcoded list) to override the list of blocked substrings via env var
- Fix bug in `GatewayService._update_or_create_tools` where a dict `auth_value` was written directly to a `VARCHAR` column without encoding, causing a `psycopg.ProgrammingError` on gateway refresh/edit
- Expose both new settings in `docker-compose.yml` so they can be controlled per-deployment
- Add unit tests covering: default patterns block, disabled allows all, custom patterns, and None passthrough

## Related

Closes #3300

Fixes patterns in tool descriptions (e.g. query syntax documentation) being incorrectly blocked, and the 500 error when editing a gateway that has dict-typed auth headers.

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body: Code review passed. Configurable forbidden patterns implementation is correct, secure (default-on), consistent with codebase patterns, and has full test coverage including the validation_strict interaction.

commits.message:
feat: make tool description forbidden patterns configurable

Add two new settings to control tool description validation:
- TOOL_DESCRIPTION_FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS_ENABLED (bool, default true): master
  switch to disable all forbidden pattern checks
- TOOL_DESCRIPTION_FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS (JSON array, default: existing list):
  override the list of blocked substrings

Integrates with existing VALIDATION_STRICT setting: when strict mode is
disabled, forbidden patterns produce a warning instead of rejecting.

Signed-off-by: Ethan Lavis <elavis00@outlook.com>
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Ethan Lavis

commits.message:
test: add validation_strict coverage for configurable forbidden patterns

Explicitly set validation_strict in all forbidden pattern tests to avoid
implicit dependency on the default. Add test for the non-strict warn-only
code path.

Signed-off-by: Ethan Lavis <elavis00@outlook.com>
Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

commits.message:
fix: harden forbidden patterns config parsing and empty-pattern edge case

- Add tool_description_forbidden_patterns to _normalize_env_list_vars()
  and _parse_list_from_env() for CSV/empty-string env var robustness
- Filter empty/blank patterns at config validation time via
  _filter_empty_forbidden_patterns() to prevent '' in v matching everything
- Add runtime guard in validate_description() to skip empty patterns
- Regenerate docs/config.schema.json to include new settings
- Add tests for empty-pattern edge case and config-level filtering

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

docs: document configurable forbidden patterns in env, charts, and docs
